summary: Launch Two Acquisition Corp., a Cayman-incorporated, Nasdaq-listed SPAC, filed an 8-K on September 15, 2026, announcing that it and target NuCube Energy, Inc. filed a Form S-4 registration statement, including a preliminary proxy/prospectus, for their previously disclosed June 30, 2026 business combination. The filing restates context on the transaction structure: a merger of wholly owned subsidiary Tesseract Merger Sub Inc. into NuCube, with NuCube becoming a public company. No economic terms, price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or closing date were disclosed in this filing; the S-4 registration, SEC review, and subsequent shareholder vote are the next steps. Watch for SEC comments, redemption levels, and any vote timing signals affecting deal certainty.
